A landmark environmental law looks ahead
abstract:
In late December 1973, the United States enacted what some would come to call “the pitbull of environmental laws.” In the 50 years since, the formidable regulatory teeth of the Endangered Species Act (ESA) have been credited with considerable successes, obliging agencies to draw upon the best available science to protect species and habitats. Yet human pressures continue to push the planet toward extinctions on a massive scale. With that prospect looming, and with scientific understanding ever changing,
Science
invited experts to discuss how the ESA has evolved and what its future might hold.
—Brad Wible
abstract_zh:
1973年12月底，美国颁布了一部后来被一些人称为“环境法中的斗牛犬”的法律。此后的50年间，《濒危物种法》（ESA）强有力的监管效力被认为取得了相当大的成效，迫使各机构利用现有最佳科学来保护物种和栖息地。然而，人类压力仍在持续推动地球走向大规模灭绝。面对这一迫在眉睫的前景，并且随着科学认识不断变化，《科学》（Science）杂志邀请专家讨论《濒危物种法》如何演变，以及其未来可能的走向。
——Brad Wible

title: Distribution of capitalized benefits from land conservation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Land conservation efforts throughout the United States sustain ecological benefits while generating wealth in the housing market through capitalization of amenities. This paper estimates the benefits of conservation that are capitalized into proximate home values and quantifies how those benefits are distributed across demographic groups. Using detailed property and household-level data from Massachusetts, we estimate that new land conservation led to $62 million in new housing wealth equity. However, houses owned by low-income or Black or Hispanic households are less likely to be located near protected areas, and hence, these populations are less likely to benefit financially. Direct study of the distribution of this new wealth from capitalized conservation is highly unequal, with the richest quartile of households receiving 43%, White households receiving 91%, and the richest White households receiving 40%, which is nearly 140% more than would be expected under equal distribution. We extend our analysis using census data for the entire United States and observe parallel patterns. We estimate that recent land conservation generated $9.8 billion in wealth through the housing market and that wealthier and White households benefited disproportionately. These findings suggest regressive and racially disparate incidence of the wealth benefits of land conservation policy.
abstract_zh: 美国各地的土地保护努力维持了生态效益，同时通过环境舒适度的资本化在住房市场上创造了财富。本文估计了被资本化到邻近住房价值中的保护效益，并量化了这些效益在不同人口群体间的分配情况。利用马萨诸塞州详细的房产和家庭层面数据，我们估计新增的土地保护带来了6200万美元的新增住房财富净值。然而，低收入家庭、黑人或西裔家庭拥有的住房，位于保护区附近的可能性较小，因此，这些人群从中获得经济收益的可能性也较小。对这一由保护资本化带来的新增财富分配的直接研究发现，其分配高度不平等：最富有的四分之一家庭获得43%，白人家庭获得91%，而最富有的白人家庭获得40%，比平均分配情况下的预期高出近140%。我们利用美国全国人口普查数据扩展了分析，并观察到类似的格局。我们估计，近期的土地保护通过住房市场产生了98亿美元的财富，且较富裕和白人家庭从中获益更为不成比例。这些发现表明，土地保护政策所带来的财富收益具有累退性，且存在种族差异。

title: Does presentation matter? An analysis of images and text in a choice experiment of green roofs
abstract: The use of images in choice experiment surveys has been increasing over time. Research on the impact of complex graphical displays of information on respondent comprehension and the quality of preference estimates yields mixed results. We contribute to this literature by leveraging a split-sample design for a choice experiment concerning green roofs in Portland, Oregon, to investigate the effects of including high-quality static images in the survey instrument and in the choice cards. We find that respondents who completed the ‘image’ version of our survey had a significantly higher total willingness to pay (TWTP) to support a new green roof program than respondents who completed the ‘text only’ version of the survey. We explore the relationship between respondent characteristics and TWTP and find that respondents with little knowledge about green roofs who completed the image survey have a TWTP that is over three times larger than text survey respondents. Our findings support the trend in the literature of using images in choice experiments but also highlight the importance of paying attention to image quality in survey design, using focus groups with mixed previous knowledge for survey refinement, and gathering information in surveys themselves about respondents’ prior knowledge about the valuation scenario.
abstract_zh: 选择实验调查中使用图像的做法随时间不断增加。关于复杂图形化信息展示对受访者理解力以及偏好估计质量影响的研究，结论好坏参半。我们利用一项关于俄勒冈州波特兰市绿色屋顶的选择实验，采用分样本设计，考察在调查问卷和选择卡中加入高质量静态图像的效果，以对这一文献作出贡献。我们发现，完成“图像”版问卷的受访者，为支持新绿色屋顶计划所表示的总支付意愿（TWTP）显著高于完成“纯文本”版问卷的受访者。我们探究了受访者特征与TWTP之间的关系，发现对绿色屋顶了解较少、且完成图像版问卷的受访者，其TWTP是文本版受访者的三倍以上。我们的研究结果支持了文献中在选择实验中使用图像的趋势，但也突出了以下几点的重要性：关注调查设计中的图像质量；利用具有不同既有知识水平的焦点小组来完善问卷；以及在调查本身中收集受访者关于估值情境既有知识的信息。

title: Valuing changes in the portfolio of service flows from climate-induced extremes on a linked food, energy, water system (C-FEWS)
abstract:
Introduction:Recent work examining the impact of climate-change induced extremes on food-energy-water systems (FEWS) estimates the potential changes in physical flows of multiple elements of the systems. Climate adaptation decisions can involve tradeoffs between different system outcomes. Thus, it is important for decision makers to consider the potential changes in monetary value attributed to the observed changes in physical flows from these events, since the value to society of a unit change in an outcome varies widely between thing like food and energy production, water quality, and carbon sequestration.
Methods:We develop a valuation tool (FEWSVT) that applies theoretically sound valuation techniques to estimates changes in value for four parameters within the food-energy-water nexus. We demonstrate the utility of the tool through the application of a case study that analyzes the monetary changes in value of a modelled heat wave scenario relative to historic (baseline) conditions in two study regions in the United States.
Results:We find that food (corn and soybeans) comprises the majority (89%) of total changes in value, as heatwaves trigger physical changes in corn and soybeans yields. We also find that specifying overly simplified and incorrect valuation methods lead to monetary values that largely differ from FEWSVT results that use accepted valuation methods.
Discussion:These results demonstrate the value in considering changes in monetary value instead of just physical flows when making decisions on how to distribute investments and address the many potential impacts of climate change-induced extremes.
abstract_zh:
引言：近期研究考察了气候变化引发的极端事件对粮食-能源-水系统（FEWS）的影响，并估计了该系统中多种要素物理流量的潜在变化。气候适应决策可能涉及系统不同结果之间的权衡。因此，决策者有必要考虑这些事件所引起的物理流量变化所对应的货币价值变化，因为社会对粮食和能源生产、水质以及碳封存等不同结果的单位变化的价值差异很大。
方法：我们开发了一个估值工具（FEWSVT），运用理论上合理的估值技术，估算粮食-能源-水关联中四个参数的价值变化。我们通过一个案例研究展示了该工具的实用性，该研究分析了美国两个研究区域中，模拟热浪情景相对于历史（基线）条件下货币价值的变化。
结果：我们发现，粮食（玉米和大豆）占总价值变化的大部分（89%），因为热浪会引起玉米和大豆产量的实际变化。我们还发现，若采用过于简化或不正确的估值方法，所得到的货币价值会与采用公认估值方法的FEWSVT结果存在很大差异。
讨论：这些结果表明，在决定如何分配投资并应对气候变化引发的极端事件的诸多潜在影响时，考虑货币价值的变化而不仅仅是物理流量的变化，具有重要价值。

title: Equity and cost-effectiveness in valuation and action planning to preserve biodiversity
abstract: Economic research and frameworks, comprehensively synthesized in “The Economics of Biodiversity: The Dasgupta Review” (Dasgupta 2021), can do much to help stem global biodiversity loss. However, ingrained features of economics as a discipline often produce explanations and solutions for environmental problems that advantage wealthy and powerful entities in our global society rather than those who are poor or otherwise marginalized. This paper highlights two dimensions of economic research related to biodiversity where disciplinary bias can lead to ineffective and inequitable work: biodiversity valuation, and targeting causes of biodiversity loss to be changed. First, it shows how valuation approaches can best be used to inform actions that capture both use and non-use values and include the perspectives and needs of people who are typically marginalized in governance processes. Second, it discusses how global action to preserve biodiversity will be cost-ineffective and inequitable unless we take at least some steps to identify and correct actions taken by wealthy countries and large-scale producers that contribute much to the biodiversity crisis, rather than focusing policy primarily on the behavior of low-income individuals and households.
abstract_zh: 经济学的研究与框架（在《生物多样性经济学：Dasgupta评论》（Dasgupta 2021）中得到了全面综述）能够在很大程度上遏制全球生物多样性丧失。然而，作为一门学科，经济学的一些根深蒂固的特征，常常对环境问题提出解释和解决方案，而这些方案有利于全球社会中的富裕和有权势的实体，而非贫困或其他被边缘化的群体。本文强调了与生物多样性相关的经济学研究的两个维度，在这两个维度上，学科偏见可能导致低效且不公平的研究：生物多样性估值，以及针对生物多样性丧失原因所需改变的对象。首先，本文展示了估值方法如何能够最好地用于指导既包括使用价值又包括非使用价值的行动，并纳入在治理过程中通常被边缘化的人群的观点与需求。其次，本文讨论了如果我们不采取至少一些措施，以识别并纠正富裕国家和大规模生产者造成生物多样性危机的行为，那么全球保护生物多样性的行动将既缺乏成本效益，又不公平；因此不应将政策重点主要放在低收入个人和家庭的行为上。

title: Homeowner willingness to pay for a pre-flood buyout agreement
abstract: Homeowner buyout programs promote climate adaptation efforts by removing homes from floodplains. We estimate homeowner willingness to pay (WTP) for a novel agreement in which they precommit to relocating if a flood severely damages their home in exchange for an expedited buyout process. We find nearly all respondents identified positive WTP to enroll in this program, with average WTP about $600. Factors like flood risk and expectation of neighbors’ responses significantly affect WTP. If the pre-flood agreement is available only if the homeowner has flood insurance, only 68% of homeowners were willing to accept the agreement.
abstract_zh: 住房所有者收购计划通过将房屋从洪泛区移出，促进气候适应。我们估计了住房所有者对一项新协议的支付意愿（WTP）：他们预先承诺，如果洪水严重损毁其住房便搬迁，以换取加快的收购程序。我们发现，几乎所有受访者都表示愿意支付正的费用以参加该计划，平均支付意愿约为600美元。洪水风险以及对邻居反应的预期等因素会显著影响支付意愿。如果洪灾前协议仅向拥有洪水保险的住房所有者开放，则只有68%的住房所有者愿意接受该协议。

title: The costs and benefits of primary prevention of zoonotic pandemics
Valuing the public benefits of green roofs
abstract: Green roofs are being incorporated into stormwater management programs around the world. While numerous studies have estimated the private benefits to the owners and residents of buildings with green roofs, the value of the multiple public benefits received by non-building residents are less well known. We use a choice experiment survey to estimate the public benefits for a proposed green roof program in Portland, Oregon, USA. These benefits include reduced combined sewer overflows, reduced urban heat island effects, and an increase in pollinators such as birds, bees and butterflies. Past investments in stormwater infrastructure have exposed some residents to poor water quality and urban flooding, so we also explore if respondents’ willingness to pay varies based on where new green roofs are located. Across models, the largest estimated benefit in our study area is from a reduction in combined sewer overflows. Model results also show that respondents prefer to not fully concentrate new green roofs in Portland’s Central City area, which is where most green roofs are currently located. Total willingness to pay estimates for the 1-year program range from around $202 to $442 per household, or $54.4 to $116.8 million for the city of Portland, Oregon, depending on program characteristics.
abstract_zh: 绿色屋顶正被纳入世界各地的雨洪管理计划。尽管已有大量研究估计了拥有绿色屋顶建筑的所有者和居住者所获得的私人收益，但非建筑居住者所享有的多种公共效益的价值却鲜为人知。我们利用一项选择实验调查，估计了美国俄勒冈州波特兰市一项拟议绿色屋顶计划的公共收益。这些收益包括减少合流制溢流污水、缓解城市热岛效应，以及增加鸟类、蜜蜂和蝴蝶等传粉者。过去对雨水基础设施的投资使部分居民暴露于水质差和城市洪涝之中，因此，我们还探讨了受访者的支付意愿是否会因新绿色屋顶的位置而有所不同。在各模型中，本研究区域内最大的估计收益来自减少合流制溢流污水。模型结果还表明，受访者倾向于不将新增绿色屋顶过度集中在波特兰市中心城区，而目前大多数绿色屋顶都位于该区域。对于为期1年的该计划，每户家庭的总支付意愿估计在约202美元至442美元之间，视计划特征而定；对于俄勒冈州波特兰市整体而言，则为5440万至1.168亿美元。

title: Assessing preferences for growth on the rural-urban fringe using a stated choice analysis
Diversifying to reduce conservation outcome uncertainty in multiple environmental objectives
abstract: In this paper we develop tools and intuition for portfolio optimization for multiple conservation objectives. We show it is more efficient to optimize a conservation portfolio for multiple goods jointly, allowing planners to exploit information about multiple dimensions of correlations between goods. We identified a new type of correlation that is important for optimal conservation planning of multiple objectives under uncertainty: scenario correlation between objectives in a given part of the landscape. The conservation planner faces a different kind of problem if the objectives at hand respond similarly rather than differently to climate shocks in subregions of the planning area.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了针对多个保护目标进行投资组合优化的工具与直觉。我们表明，联合优化多种保护品的投资组合更为有效，使规划者能够利用多个维度相关性的信息。我们识别出一种对不确定性下多目标最优保护规划很重要的新型相关性：景观中某一部分内各目标之间的情景相关性。若规划区域内的不同目标对子区域中气候冲击的反应相似而非不同，则保护规划者所面临的问题类型也会不同。

title: The economics of species conservation
abstract: A quarter of all species around the globe are threatened with extinction; this article reviews research in economics on how best to counter those threats. Normative research has developed useful tools for cost-effectively choosing areas of habitat to protect. Such work has also designed working-lands contracts that can induce efficient quantities and patterns of conservation on private lands. Positive research finds evidence that payments for ecosystem service programs are effective, but legal protections for threatened species have a mixed record of success. Economists have also measured both the nonmarket benefits and the costs of species conservation. Emerging work is tackling the particular challenges to species conservation posed by climate change, the demand for exploiting charismatic megafauna, and global population growth. Future research would do well to build on those three areas and to study distributional issues in the benefits and costs of species conservation.
abstract_zh: 全球约四分之一的物种面临灭绝威胁；本文综述了经济学领域关于如何最有效应对这些威胁的研究。规范性研究已发展出有用的工具，用于以成本效益方式选择需要保护的栖息地区域。此类工作还设计了农业用地合同，能够在私人土地上诱导出有效的保护数量和格局。实证研究发现，生态系统服务付费计划是有效的，但对濒危物种的法律保护成效参差不齐。经济学家还测算了物种保护的非市场效益和成本。新兴研究正在应对气候变化、对魅力大型动物（charismatic megafauna）开发利用的需求以及全球人口增长给物种保护带来的特殊挑战。未来研究最好能在这三个领域的基础上继续推进，并研究物种保护收益与成本的分配问题。

title: When portfolio theory can help environmental investment planning to reduce climate risk to future environmental outcomes - and when it cannot
Fine-resolution conservation planning with limited climate-change information
The economic value of grassland species for carbon storage
abstract: Carbon storage by ecosystems is valuable for climate protection. Biodiversity conservation may help increase carbon storage, but the value of this influence has been difficult to assess. We use plant, soil, and ecosystem carbon storage data from two grassland biodiversity experiments to show that greater species richness increases economic value: Increasing species richness from 1 to 10 had twice the economic value of increasing species richness from 1 to 2. The marginal value of each additional species declined as species accumulated, reflecting the nonlinear relationship between species richness and plant biomass production. Our demonstration of the economic value of biodiversity for enhancing carbon storage provides a foundation for assessing the value of biodiversity for decisions about land management. Combining carbon storage with other ecosystem services affected by biodiversity may well enhance the economic arguments for conservation even further.
abstract_zh: 生态系统的碳储存对于气候保护具有重要价值。生物多样性保护可能有助于增加碳储存，但这种影响的价值一直难以评估。我们利用两项草地生物多样性实验中的植物、土壤和生态系统碳储存数据，表明物种丰富度的增加会提升经济价值：将物种丰富度从1增加到10所产生的经济价值，是从1增加到2的两倍。随着物种不断累积，每增加一个物种的边际价值递减，这反映了物种丰富度与植物生物量生产之间的非线性关系。我们对生物多样性在增强碳储存方面经济价值的论证，为评估生物多样性对土地管理决策的价值奠定了基础。将碳储存与受生物多样性影响的其他生态系统服务结合起来，可能会进一步增强保护的经济论据。

title: Permanent and temporary policy incentives for conservation under stochastic returns from competing land uses
abstract: Rapid conversion of private land for agricultural and urban use has raised concern worldwide over the loss of ecological services. To inform conservation policy, we model privately optimal land use decisions using a real options framework that assumes both the ecological and commercial values of land are stochastic and that land conversion is irreversible. We analyze permanent and temporary land conservation policy incentives using this dynamic framework to guide policy makers interested in designing efficient payment mechanisms to achieve ecological preservation goals. We find that while the financial cost of temporary policy incentives is generally much lower than permanent policy incentives, this difference is very small in scenarios with high discount rates and lower uncertainties in conversion returns and lower expected trend in conservation returns. Alternately, the financial cost of temporary conservation is substantially lower than that of permanent conservation when the expected trend in conservation returns and uncertainties in conservation and conversion returns is high and the discount rate is low. Comparison with net present value and single‐source uncertainty models indicates that the presence of a second uncertainty increases the option value of delaying conversion, and shows that permanent and temporary policy incentives based on either of the two simpler models can be seriously misguided if multiple uncertainties are present. We illustrate the analytical results with a case study of tropical deforestation in Indonesia where private landowners can either conserve forests and earn carbon credits, or convert to palm oil agriculture and earn profits from the sale of palm oil.
abstract_zh: 私人土地快速转化为农业和城市用途，已引起全球对生态服务丧失的担忧。为了为保护政策提供依据，我们利用实物期权框架对私人最优土地利用决策进行建模，该框架假定土地的生态价值和商业价值均具有随机性，且土地转换是不可逆的。我们利用这一动态框架分析永久性和临时性土地保护政策激励，为旨在设计有效支付机制以实现生态保护目标的政策制定者提供指导。我们发现，虽然临时性政策激励的财务成本通常远低于永久性政策激励，但在贴现率高、转换收益不确定性低且保护收益预期趋势较低的情景下，这一差异非常小。相反，当保护收益的预期趋势以及保护与转换收益的不确定性较高、且贴现率较低时，临时性保护的财务成本则大幅低于永久性保护。与净现值模型和单一不确定性来源模型的比较表明，第二种不确定性的存在会提高推迟转换的期权价值；若存在多种不确定性，仅基于两种较简单模型的永久性和临时性政策激励可能会造成严重误导。我们以印度尼西亚热带森林砍伐的案例说明了分析结果：在该案例中，私人土地所有者既可以保护森林并获得碳信用，也可以转为棕榈油农业并从棕榈油销售中获利。

title: Spatially-correlated risk in nature reserve site selection
The economics of conservation and finance: A review of the literature
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: This article summarizes key insights into conservation that come from the intersections of economics and finance: public finance, conservation finance, and financial theory applied to problems of conservation. We discuss some of what has been learned from the study of conservation and finance that helps us to understand when, where, and even whether conservation activities should occur; portfolio theory has been harnessed to help guide conservation planning under uncertainty, and real options theory helps us understand whether to commit to conservation or to wait. We distill some of the extant research on how resources can be gathered to support conservation through local referenda, payment for environmental service programs, private donations, user fees, and value capture through property taxes. The article concludes with suggestions for promising future directions in this area of work.
abstract_zh: 本文总结了经济学与金融学交叉领域关于保护的关键见解，包括公共财政、保护融资，以及应用于保护问题的金融理论。我们讨论了通过研究保护与金融所获得的一些认识，这些认识有助于我们理解何时、何地，甚至是否应开展保护活动：组合理论已被用于指导不确定性下的保护规划，而实物期权理论则有助于我们理解应当现在承诺保护还是等待。我们梳理了现有研究中关于如何通过地方公投、环境服务付费计划、私人捐赠、使用者费用以及通过财产税进行价值捕获来筹集保护资金的一些研究。文章最后提出了该领域未来有前景的研究方向。

title: A conservation planning approach to mitigating the impacts of leakage from protected area networks
abstract: Protected area networks are designed to restrict anthropogenic pressures in areas of high biodiversity. Resource users respond by seeking to replace some or all of the lost resources from locations elsewhere in the landscape. Protected area networks thereby perturb the pattern of human pressures by displacing extractive effort from within protected areas into the broader landscape, a process known as leakage. The negative effects of leakage on conservation outcomes have been empirically documented and modeled using homogeneous descriptions of conservation landscapes. Human resource use and biodiversity vary greatly in space, however, and a theory of leakage must describe how this heterogeneity affects the magnitude, pattern, and biodiversity impacts of leakage. We combined models of household utility, adaptive human foraging, and biodiversity conservation to provide a bioeconomic model of leakage that accounts for spatial heterogeneity. Leakage had strong and divergent impacts on the performance of protected area networks, undermining biodiversity benefits but mitigating the negative impacts on local resource users. When leakage was present, our model showed that poorly designed protected area networks resulted in a substantial net loss of biodiversity. However, the effects of leakage can be mitigated if they are incorporated ex-ante into the conservation planning process. If protected areas are coupled with nonreserve policy instruments such as market subsidies, our model shows that the trade-offs between biodiversity and human well-being can be further and more directly reduced.
abstract_zh: 保护区网络旨在限制高生物多样性地区的人为压力。资源使用者会设法从景观中其他地点替代部分或全部损失的资源。因此，保护区网络通过将采掘活动从保护区内转移到更广阔的景观中，扰乱了人类压力的格局，这一过程被称为“泄漏”（leakage）。泄漏对保护成效的负面影响已有实证记录，并已利用对保护景观的同质化描述进行了建模。然而，人类的资源利用和生物多样性在空间上差异很大，因此，泄漏理论必须描述这种异质性如何影响泄漏的规模、格局以及生物多样性影响。我们结合家庭效用模型、适应性人类觅食模型和生物多样性保护模型，提出了一个考虑空间异质性的泄漏生物经济模型。泄漏对保护区网络的绩效产生了强烈且相反的影响：它削弱了生物多样性收益，但减轻了对当地资源使用者的负面影响。当存在泄漏时，我们的模型表明，设计不良的保护区网络会导致生物多样性的大量净损失。然而，若事先将泄漏效应纳入保护规划过程，其影响可以得到缓解。若将保护区与市场补贴等非保留区政策工具相结合，我们的模型表明，生物多样性与人类福祉之间的权衡可以被进一步、更直接地降低。

title: Downside versus symmetric measures of uncertainty in natural resource portfolio design to manage climate change uncertainty
abstract: Recent work uses Markowitz’s mean-variance framework to identify efficient allocations of conservation activity across subregions of a planning landscape to minimize climate change–induced uncertainty in future conservation benefits. We replace variance with a downside measure of uncertainty and compare the resulting portfolios of conservation activity and uncertainty–expected value results against those generated by the mean-variance approach. Results illustrate that conservation agents can manage climate changed–induced uncertainty in future conservation outcomes more efficiently using our framework when they are particularly averse to downside uncertainty and when predicted future conservation outcomes within subregions across their planning horizon exhibit skewed distributions. (JEL D81, Q57)
abstract_zh: 近期研究利用马科维茨（Markowitz）的均值-方差框架，在规划区域的各子区域之间识别保护活动的有效配置，以最小化气候变化引发的未来保护收益的不确定性。我们用下行风险度量取代方差，并将由此得到的保护活动组合及不确定性-期望值结果，与均值-方差方法所得结果进行比较。结果表明，当保护主体特别厌恶下行不确定性，且规划期内各子区域未来预测的保护结果呈偏态分布时，采用我们的框架，保护主体可以更有效地管理气候变化引发的未来保护成果的不确定性。（JEL D81, Q57）

title: Simple-but-sound methods for estimating the value of changes in biodiversity for biological pest control in agriculture
Implementing efficient conservation portfolio design
Spatial environmental and resource economics
Valuing grassland restoration: Proximity to substitutes and tradeoffs among conservation attributes
Water quality trading with lumpy investments, credit stacking, and ancillary benefits
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: This paper studies the economics of a water quality trading market in a predominantly agricultural watershed, and explores the effects of credit stacking in such a market when buyers and sellers of pollution credits can only reduce pollution with large, discrete investments that yield discontinuous supply and demand. The research simulates hypothetical water quality trading markets in the corn‐belt area of Illinois, where wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) can pay farmers to reduce nutrients by installing wetlands and farmers may or may not be allowed to earn payments for multiple services from one wetland. We find that wetlands are a more cost‐effective way to mitigate nitrogen pollution than abatement byWWTPs. Stacking credits may improve social welfare while providing more ecosystem services if there is enough demand for the primary credit in the market (nitrogen) to cover most of the cost of installing the wetland but the supply of nitrogen credits is not exhausted. However, in the presence of lumpy pollution reduction activities, the effects of allowing stacked credit sales are idiosyncratic and not necessarily positive; stacked payments may or may not satisfy additionality. The results imply that credit trading for nitrogen is likely to make society better off, but the effects of allowing farmers to receive multiple payments from a single wetland depend on details of the situation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个以农业为主的流域中水质交易市场的经济学，并探讨了当污染信用的买方和卖方只能通过大规模、不连续的投资来减少污染，从而产生不连续的供给与需求时，此类市场中信用叠加的影响。研究模拟了伊利诺伊州玉米带地区的假设性水质交易市场，在该地区，污水处理厂（WWTPs）可以向农民付费，由农民建设湿地以减少养分排放；农民可能被允许或不被允许从同一湿地获得多项服务的付款。我们发现，相比于污水处理厂自身减排，湿地是减少氮污染更具成本效益的方式。若市场中主要信用（氮）的需求足以覆盖建设湿地的大部分成本，而氮信用的供给尚未耗尽，那么叠加信用可能在提供更多生态系统服务的同时改善社会福利。然而，在存在大块式（lumpy）污染减排活动的情况下，允许叠加信用销售的效果具有特殊性，且不一定是正面的；叠加支付可能满足也可能不满足额外性（additionality）要求。研究结果表明，氮信用交易很可能使社会福利改善，但允许农民从单一湿地获得多项付款的效果则取决于具体情况的细节。

title: Valuing preferences over stormwater management outcomes given state-dependent preferences and heterogeneous status quo
Benefits of pollution monitoring technology for greenhouse gas offset markets
Optimal portfolio design to reduce climate related conservation uncertainty in the Prairie Pothole Region
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Climate change is likely to alter the spatial distributions of species and habitat types but the nature of such change is uncertain. Thus, climate change makes it difficult to implement standard conservation planning paradigms. Previous work has suggested some approaches to cope with such uncertainty but has not harnessed all of the benefits of risk diversification. We adapt Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT) to optimal spatial targeting of conservation activity, using wetland habitat conservation in the Prairie Pothole Region (PPR) as an example. This approach finds the allocations of conservation activity among subregions of the planning area that maximize the expected conservation returns for a given level of uncertainty or minimize uncertainty for a given expected level of returns. We find that using MPT instead of simple diversification in the PPR can achieve a value of the conservation objective per dollar spent that is 15% higher for the same level of risk. MPT-based portfolios can also have 21% less uncertainty over benefits or 6% greater expected benefits than the current portfolio of PPR conservation. Total benefits from conservation investment are higher if returns are defined in terms of benefit–cost ratios rather than benefits alone. MPT-guided diversification can work to reduce the climate-change–induced uncertainty of future ecosystem-service benefits from many land policy and investment initiatives, especially when outcomes are negatively correlated between subregions of a planning area.
abstract_zh: 气候变化可能会改变物种和栖息地类型的空间分布，但这种变化的性质尚不确定。因此，气候变化使标准的保护规划范式难以实施。以往研究提出了一些应对这种不确定性的方法，但未能充分利用风险分散的全部益处。我们将现代投资组合理论（MPT）应用于保护活动的最优空间配置，并以草原坑洼地区（Prairie Pothole Region，PPR）的湿地栖息地保护为例。该方法找出规划区域各子区域之间的保护活动分配方案，在给定不确定性水平下使保护的期望收益最大化，或在给定期望收益水平下使不确定性最小化。我们发现，在PPR中使用现代投资组合理论而非简单分散化，在同等风险水平下可使每单位支出的保护目标价值高出15%。基于MPT的投资组合在收益方面的不确定性也可比PPR现行保护组合低21%，或期望收益高出6%。若以效益-成本比而非仅以收益来定义回报，保护投资的总收益会更高。MPT指导下的分散化可以在许多土地政策和投资计划中降低气候变化引起的未来生态系统服务收益的不确定性，尤其是在规划区域各子区域结果呈负相关时。

title: Protected-area fragmentation, roads, and private conservation
venue: Letters in Spatial and Resources Sciences

title: Consumer demand for green technology in an urban setting: The case of Chicago rain barrels
abstract: Hydrological disruption and water pollution from urbanization can be reduced if households adopt decentralized stormwater controls. We use spatial data from Chicago’s rain barrel program to explore what factors influence adoption of durable green technology that provides public goods in an urban setting. We find that owner-occupancy is positively correlated with green-technology adoption; rental housing may have inefficiently low levels of adoption due to principal-agent problems. More rain barrels are adopted in places with a high-income ideologically-green population, but we find that rain barrel purchases are not correlated with local levels of flooding. Results indicate that policy makers might increase green-technology adoption by reducing transaction costs and providing education programs.
abstract_zh: 如果家庭采用分散式雨水控制措施，城市化带来的水文扰动和水污染是可以减轻的。我们利用芝加哥雨水桶计划的空间数据，探讨哪些因素影响了能够提供城市公共品的耐用型绿色技术的采用。我们发现，自住型住房与绿色技术的采用呈正相关；由于委托人-代理问题，租赁住房的采用水平可能低得缺乏效率。在收入较高且意识形态上倾向绿色的人口集中地区，雨水桶的采用更多，但我们发现雨水桶的购买与当地洪涝水平并不相关。结果表明，政策制定者可以通过降低交易成本和提供教育计划来提高绿色技术的采用率。

title: Economic costs, benefits, and achievability of low-impact development based stormwater regulations
venue: Economic Incentives for Stormwater Control (Taylor & Francis)

title: Lessons from finance for new land-conservation strategies given climate-change uncertainty
Optimal contract lengths for voluntary ecosystem service provision with varied dynamic benefit functions
abstract: Programs to stimulate provision of terrestrial environmental services yield benefits that result from complex dynamic functions; we study optimal contract lengths for such programs. We show that the optimal contract length depends on a tradeoff between an ecological effect—long contracts increase the environmental benefits from one landowner—and an enrollment effect—long contracts decrease the number of landowners enrolled. In a simplified model of the contracting environment, we find that optimal contracts are longer when environmental benefits mature slowly, but it may not be best to offer permanent easements or even to offer contracts as long as the maturation period for the benefits in question. Nonecological characteristics matter to contract design as well; optimal contracts are longer where the turnover rate of parcels enrolled in conservation programs is high and where the average private land income is low.
abstract_zh: 旨在促进陆地环境服务供给的计划所产生的收益，源于复杂的动态函数；我们研究这类计划的最优合同期限。我们表明，最优合同期限取决于两种效应之间的权衡：生态效应，即长期合同增加了单个土地所有者带来的环境收益；以及参与效应，即长期合同减少了参与计划的土地所有者数量。在一个简化的合同环境模型中，我们发现，当环境收益成熟缓慢时，最优合同更长；但提供永久地役权，甚至提供与收益成熟期等长的合同，未必是最佳做法。非生态特征同样影响合同设计：在保护计划所涉地块周转率较高、且私人土地平均收入较低的地区，最优合同更长。

title: Demand-side factors in optimal land conservation choice
abstract: The dominant paradigm of conservation-reserve planning in economics is to optimize the provision of physical conservation benefits given a budget constraint, implicitly assuming the value of biodiversity and ecosystem function is not affected by human proximity to that natural capital. There is evidence, however, that human willingness to pay (WTP) for conservation declines with distance - a phenomenon we call “spatial value decay”. This paper begins a new strand of the conservation planning literature that takes demand-side factors - location of people in the landscape, the degree to which WTP for conservation depends on proximity - into account. We use theoretical models of linear abstract landscapes to explore the impact of demand-side factors on two facets of conservation choices: siting of a single reserve when conservation potential is greatest near a critical site, and siting of multiple reserves when fragmentation reduces physical conservation services produced. Our results show how planners should sometimes employ increased fragmentation to capture value when people’s preferences are not very highly localized, and how optimal policy balances proximity to the ecologically critical site with proximity to people. In some scenarios, the payoff to using a reserve design approach that considers demand-side factors is large, but we find that spatial value decay reduces the benefits that can be gained from any conservation-planning approach.
abstract_zh: 经济学中保护区规划的主导范式，是在预算约束下优化物理保护效益的供给，隐含地假定生物多样性和生态功能的价值不受人类与该自然资本接近程度的影响。然而，有证据表明，人们对保护的支付意愿（WTP）随距离增加而下降，我们将这一现象称为“空间价值衰减”。本文开启了保护规划文献的一条新分支，将需求侧因素纳入考虑，包括人们在景观中的位置，以及对保护的支付意愿依赖于邻近程度的程度。我们利用线性抽象景观的理论模型，考察需求侧因素对保护选择两方面的影响：当保护潜力在关键地点附近最大时单个保护区的选址，以及当碎片化减少了所提供的物理保护服务时多个保护区的选址。我们的结果表明，当人们的偏好不是非常局域化时，规划者有时应当利用增加碎片化的方式来获取价值；并且最优政策需要在靠近生态关键地点与靠近人群之间进行权衡。在某些情景下，采用考虑需求侧因素的保护区设计方法所获得的收益很大，但我们发现，空间价值衰减会降低任何保护规划方法所能获得的收益。

title: Market and social welfare effects of the Renewable Fuels Standard
venue: Handbook of Bioenergy Economics and Policy

title: Defensive purchasing, the safety (dis)advantage of light trucks, and motor-vehicle policy effectiveness
Science, economics, and the design of conservation programs in the U.S
venue: Journal of Environmental Planning and Management

title: The political economy of policy adoption: State-level natural resource damage programs
A spatial-econometric analysis of attraction and repulsion of private conservation by public reserves
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Private land trusts protect much land in the U.S., but private groups may fail to coordinate conservation decisions with other conservation agents. Furthermore, it is difficult for public agencies to make optimal reserve-site selections without knowing how these public reserves might influence the configuration of private conservation. Because the configuration of conservation contributes to the total benefits land provides, we analyze spatial data on conservation in California, Illinois and Massachusetts to explore relationships between the locations of private and public conservation land. We find evidence that private protected acres are clustered together in space. In California, we find that private land conservation is attracted towards places where the government has reserves. In contrast, we find that government reserves in Illinois and Massachusetts act to shift private conservation away from the townships in which they are located in a mixture of spatial repulsion and simple acreage displacement.
abstract_zh: 美国的私人土地信托保护了大量土地，但私人团体可能无法与其他保护主体协调其保育决策。此外，若不了解公共保护区可能如何影响私人保育的空间格局，公共机构也很难做出最优的保护区选址。由于保育的空间格局会影响土地所提供的总体效益，我们利用加利福尼亚州、伊利诺伊州和马萨诸塞州的保育空间数据，考察私人保育用地与公共保育用地位置之间的关系。我们发现，私人保护的土地在空间上存在集聚。在加利福尼亚州，私人土地保育会被吸引至政府保护区所在的地方。相反，在伊利诺伊州和马萨诸塞州，政府保护区会使私人保育远离其所在的镇区，表现为空间排斥与简单的面积替代相结合的格局。

title: Patterns of multi-agent land conservation: Crowding in/out, agglomeration, and policy
abstract: This paper explores the spatial equilibrium patterns of land conservation that derive from a game between land conservation agents who provide public goods. The shape of the conservation benefit function determines whether one agent's conservation crowds in/out conservation by the other agent. Value for contiguity of conservation can produce: "spatial attraction," more conservation, and spatially-strategic behavior. The level of social benefits attained in the game depends on budget constraints, game structure, and the similarity between agents' objectives. The paper uses this spatially-explicit game structure to analyze special cases including hot-spots, high-cost parcels, agglomeration bonuses, and localized land trusts.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了由提供公共品的土地保育主体之间的博弈所形成的土地保育空间均衡模式。保育收益函数的形状决定了一方的保育行为是挤入还是挤出另一方的保育。对毗连性保育的价值重视，可能产生“空间吸引”、更多的保育以及空间策略性行为。博弈中所能获得的社会效益水平，取决于预算约束、博弈结构以及各主体目标之间的相似程度。本文利用这一具有空间明确性的博弈结构，分析了若干特例，包括热点地区、高成本地块、集聚奖励以及地方性土地信托。

title: Welfare effects and unintended consequences of ethanol subsidies
Examples and principles of state-level rural environmental initiatives
venue: Journal of Regional Analysis and Policy
abstract: The paper provides recommendations for state policy related to water pollution and species conservation which employ pollution standards, economic incentives, liability policy enforcement, and measures to improve the technical capacity of state environmental agencies. These problems are likely to be important in many states, and thinking through them provides an opportunity to showcase some general principles of state environmental policy formation.
abstract_zh: 本文针对水污染与物种保护问题，就州一级政策提出建议，这些政策涉及污染标准、经济激励、责任追究执行以及提升州环境机构技术能力的措施。这些问题在许多州可能都很重要，对其进行梳理，也为展示州环境政策制定的若干一般原则提供了契机。

title: Envelope backs or the gold standard: Choosing damage-assessment accuracy
The roles of ownership, ecology, and economics in public wetland- conservation decisions
Tradable discharge permits: A student-friendly game
Recycling in multi-family dwellings: Does convenience matter?
Natural resource damage assessment methods: Lessons in simplicity from state trustees
abstract: When natural resource damages are caused by releases of hazardous materials into the environment, government trustees must conduct Natural Resource Damage Assessments (NRDAs) to support claims to recover the value of lost or damaged resources. This article sets forth theoretical arguments that support efforts to develop unbiased simplified NRDA methods for use by government trustees and proposes a set of criteria that can be used to evaluate the quality of any such simplified method. The authors then describe the simplified methods being used by five states across the country, affording academic economists a rare view of the kinds of methods state agencies use in‐house. The article evaluates those methods against the criteria set forth and discusses the potential of other nonstate‐specific simplified NRDA methods (benefit transfer and Type A models) to do the job better. The new framework established can guide future research to design simplified methods that are less biased than the simplified methods currently in use by some states without compromising ease of implementation. (JEL Q5, K32)
abstract_zh: 当有害物质释放到环境中造成自然资源损害时，政府受托人必须开展自然资源损害评估（NRDA），以支持其为追偿受损或丧失资源的价值而提出的索赔。本文提出了理论论证，支持政府受托人开发无偏的简化NRDA方法，并提出了一套可用于评价任何此类简化方法质量的标准。随后，作者描述了全国五个州正在使用的简化方法，使学术经济学家得以难得一见地了解州机构内部所采用的方法类型。本文依据所提出的标准对这些方法进行了评价，并讨论了其他非特定于州的简化NRDA方法（效益转移法和A类模型）在完成这一任务上做得更好的潜力。所建立的新框架可以指导未来的研究，以设计出比部分州目前使用的简化方法偏差更小、同时又不牺牲实施便利性的简化方法。（JEL Q5, K32）

Do interest groups compete? An application to endangered species
Economies of scope in endangered-species protection: Evidence from interest-group behavior

venue: Endangered Species Protection in the United States

title: Why economics matters for endangered species protection and the ESA

title: Are vehicle emission inspection programs living up to expectations?
abstract: To ensure that the advanced emission control systems installed on modern motor vehicles continue to work properly, motor vehicle inspection and maintenance (I/M) programs are now found in the major cities of many countries around the world. These programs are widely regarded as valuable and even essential to the achievement of air quality objectives, but there have been few ex post audits of these programs. In this paper, we examine the performance of one of the most sophisticated I/M programs, the USEPA’s Enhanced I/M Program. This program has now been implemented in five states. Using data from 1995 and 1996, we estimate the cost of the Arizona Enhanced I/M Program and the emission reductions achieved. We begin by enumerating briefly the components of I/M costs and discuss their size and incidence. Then we describe the empirical information from Arizona and how we use it to construct cost estimates for both vehicle inspection and repair of failing vehicles. Inspection costs include the costs of operating the test stations and the costs motorists incur in time and money to get to the station and go through the testing process. We find that the inspection costs account for over two-thirds of the full costs of I/M, while costs associated with actual vehicle repair account for only one-third. We conclude by comparing the empirical estimates of costs and program effectiveness in the Arizona program with the ex ante estimated Enhanced I/M program costs made by the EPA in the 1992 Regulatory Impact Analysis (RIA). The ex ante EPA analysis appears to have underestimated the costs of achieving the ambitious reductions in emissions hoped for under I/M. JEL classification: Q25
abstract_zh: 为确保现代机动车安装的先进排放控制系统持续正常工作，目前世界上许多国家的主要城市都设有机动车检测与维护（I/M）项目。这些项目被普遍认为对实现空气质量目标具有重要价值，甚至是不可或缺的，但对其进行的事后审计却很少。本文考察了最为完善的I/M项目之一——美国环保署的强化I/M项目（Enhanced I/M Program）的运行绩效。该项目目前已在五个州实施。利用1995年和1996年的数据，我们估算了亚利桑那州强化I/M项目的成本及其实现的减排量。我们首先简要列出I/M成本的构成部分，并讨论其规模与分布。随后，我们描述了来自亚利桑那州的实证信息，以及如何利用这些信息构建车辆检测与故障车辆维修两方面的成本估算。检测成本包括检测站的运营成本，以及机动车车主在时间和金钱上为前往检测站并完成检测流程而承担的成本。我们发现，检测成本占I/M全部成本的三分之二以上，而与实际车辆维修相关的成本仅占三分之一。最后，我们将亚利桑那州项目的实证成本与效果估计，同美国环保署在1992年《监管影响分析》（RIA）中事前估算的强化I/M项目成本进行了比较。事前的环保署分析似乎低估了实现I/M所期望的雄心勃勃减排目标的成本。JEL分类号：Q25

title: Costs, emission reductions and vehicle repair: Evidence from Arizona
venue: Journal of the Air and Waste Management Association

title: Environmental costs and benefits of genetically modified crops: Implications for regulatory strategies
abstract: This article sets forth a framework for evaluating the environmental costs and benefits associated with agricultural genetically modified organisms (GMOs), including impacts on plants, humans, animals, and the environment at large. The authors build on this knowledge to explore how and why GMOs should be regulated, highlighting the need for policy makers to bear in mind that genetically modified seeds might substitute for traditional agricultural practices which themselves have detrimental impacts on the environment. To guide regulation formation, the authors present a review of the literature in environmental economics on optimal and second-best regulation, where the latter is used in the face of real-world complications. They then evaluate how current regulations measure up to those theoretical ideals. Finally, the authors provide some insight into what GMO crop regulation might accomplish by reviewing the evidence on the effects of pesticide regulations.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于评估与农业转基因生物（GMO）相关的环境成本与效益，包括对植物、人类、动物以及整体环境的影响。作者在此基础上探讨了转基因生物应如何以及为何需要监管，并强调政策制定者需要注意，转基因种子可能替代那些本身对环境有负面影响的传统农业做法。为指导监管制度的制定，作者回顾了环境经济学中关于最优监管与次优监管的文献，其中次优监管适用于存在现实复杂性的情形。随后，作者评估了现行监管与这些理论理想之间的差距。最后，作者通过回顾农药监管效果的证据，进一步探讨了转基因作物监管可能取得的成效。

title: Estimating full IM240 emissions from partial test results: Evidence from Arizona
venue: Journal of the Air and Waste Management Association
abstract: The expense and inconvenience of enhanced-vehicle-emissions testing using the full 240-second dynamometer test has led states to search for ways to shorten the test process. In fact, all states that currently use the IM240 allow some type of fast-pass, usually as early in the test as second 31, and Arizona has allowed vehicles to fast-fail after second 93. While these shorter tests save states millions of dollars in inspection lanes and driver costs, there is a loss of information since test results are no longer comparable across vehicles. This paper presents a methodology for estimating full 240-second results from partial-test results for three pollutants: HC, CO, and NOx. If states can convert all tests to consistent IM240 readings, they will be able to better characterize fleet emissions and to evaluate the impact of inspection and maintenance and other programs on emissions over time. Using a random sample of vehicles in Arizona which received full 240-second tests, we use regression analysis to estimate the relationship between emissions at second 240 and emissions at earlier seconds in the test. We examine the influence of other variables such as age, model-year group, and the pollution level itself on this relationship. We also use the estimated coefficients in several applications. First, we try to shed light on the frequent assertion that the results of the dynamometer test provide guidance for vehicle repair of failing vehicles. Using a probit analysis, we find that the probability that a failing vehicle will pass the test on the first retest is greater the longer the test has progressed. Second, we test the accuracy of our estimates for forecasting fleet emissions from partial-test emissions results in Arizona. We find forecasted fleet average emissions to be very close to the actual fleet averages for light-duty vehicles, but not quite as good for trucks, particularly when NOx emissions are forecast.
abstract_zh: 使用完整240秒底盘测功机测试的强化车辆排放检测成本高昂且不便，促使各州设法缩短检测过程。事实上，目前使用IM240的所有州都允许某种形式的快速合格通过，通常最早在第31秒即可，而亚利桑那州则允许车辆在第93秒后快速判定不合格。虽然这些较短的测试为各州节省了数百万美元的检测线和司机成本，但也造成了信息损失，因为测试结果不再能够在不同车辆之间进行比较。本文提出了一种方法，可从部分测试结果估算三种污染物（HC、CO和NOx）的完整240秒结果。如果各州能够将所有测试转换为一致的IM240读数，就能够更好地刻画车队排放特征，并随时间评估检测维护及其他项目对排放的影响。利用亚利桑那州接受完整240秒测试的随机样本车辆，我们通过回归分析估计了第240秒的排放量与测试中较早时点排放量之间的关系。我们还考察了车龄、车型年份组别以及污染水平本身等其他变量对该关系的影响。此外，我们还将估计系数应用于若干场景。首先，我们试图澄清一种常见的论断，即测功机测试的结果能为故障车辆的维修提供指导。通过概率单位（probit）分析，我们发现，测试进行得越久，故障车辆在首次复测中通过的概率就越高。其次，我们检验了利用部分测试排放结果预测亚利桑那州车队排放的估计准确性。我们发现，对于轻型车辆，预测的车队平均排放与实际车队平均值非常接近，但对于卡车则稍逊一筹，尤其是在预测氮氧化物（NOx）排放时。

title: Waiting to be protected under the Endangered Species Act: The political economy of regulatory delay
Why economics matters for endangered species protection
Species distributions, land values, and efficient conservation
abstract: Efforts at species conservation in the United States have tended to be opportunistic and uncoordinated. Recently, however, ecologists and economists have begun to develop more systematic approaches. Here, the problem of efficiently allocating scarce conservation resources in the selection of sites for biological reserves is addressed. With the use of county-level data on land prices and the incidence of endangered species, it is shown that accounting for heterogeneity in land prices results in a substantial increase in efficiency in terms of either the cost of achieving a fixed coverage of species or the coverage attained from a fixed budget.
abstract_zh: 美国的物种保育工作往往具有机会主义色彩且缺乏协调。然而，近来生态学家和经济学家已开始发展更为系统的方法。本文探讨了在选择生物保护区地点时，如何有效配置稀缺保育资源的问题。利用县级土地价格数据和濒危物种的分布数据，我们表明，考虑土地价格的异质性能够显著提高效率，无论是以实现固定物种覆盖率的成本衡量，还是以固定预算所能达到的覆盖率衡量。
